how: copies of the delivered gate under gitignored tests/engineering/T02/.work/r06-repro/<variant>/ with ROOT/CONFIG/WORK and the pinned totals patched; the delivered files are never touched. Each variant is EXPECTED to exit 1; a variant that goes green would mean the guard is decorative.
unsyncedVariants: delivered gate, gate-side LEFT/RIGHT constants unchanged: a non-conforming entry stops yielding a usable probe value, so both the labels and part of the behaviour battery go red together. syncedVariants: same config widening, plus the gate's own LEFT/RIGHT expectation widened to match, so the 11 per-value labels stay green: only the behavioural probes may fail. This is the form that proves the punctuation/underscore super-string controls are load-bearing.
